notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
